title: The Commodities Cup: trade oil, gas, and copper for a share of $10,000 USDG
content:
TL;DR




The Commodities Cup runs from August 20 to September 20, 2026, with a $10,000 USDG prize pool spread across 200 places.



Eligible markets are WTI Oil Perp, Brent Oil Perp, Natural Gas Perp, and Copper Perp, all scored on one combined leaderboard.



Traders are ranked by realized PnL on closed positions rather than trading volume, with a $1 realized PnL minimum to qualify.



The competition is open to eligible Kraken clients outside the EEA, US, UK, Canada and Australia.
